limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: Identify yourself! Who are you? And where am I?
Woah, calm down! No need to get all fiesty. You wouldn't be able to harm me, even if you tried your hardest, y'know? Being a ghost, and all.

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: What? A ghost? So I really am dead aren't I...?

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: Again, not quite! You seem to be in LIMBO

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: LIMBO?

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: Yes! LIMBO, a place between the world of the living and the afterlife!

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: So I am dead?

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: Well physically you are, but it seems that your SOUL is still living.

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: B- but how?! Shouldn't this be the end for me?

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: Well it seems like although your physical self has given up on itself, your SOUL is still determined to keep fighting. And it won't stop until it is satisfied.

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: But how? If I'm physically dead, how can I continue fighting? Won't that mean I'm stuck in this void forever?

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: It seems that way to me. But may I ask what is fueling this determination of yours?

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: Well I am-... or atleast I was, cursed by something unknown, and was trying to find a cure to stop it from spreading..

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: But what does it matter to you anyway?

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: It matters to me, because I might be able to get you back on your feet. But only for a small price of course

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: I'm not letting you control my body.

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: Not your body, silly. I do not care for some cursed human. What I do care about, however, are MARROW SHARDS.

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: Marrow what now? What is that?

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: MARROW SHARDS, they're fragments of a SOUL that grant strength to beings in the afterlife.

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: These MARROW SHARDS leave a living being whenever they've been killed, and since you've experienced death before, you'll be able to see them and collect them.

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: I'm willing to give you a second chance in life, by returning you back to the start of your journey, and in return you can collect these MARROW SHARDS and hand them to me.

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: No deal.

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: NO DEAL!?! This is a deal of a lifetime we're talking about! I can quite literally bring you back from the dead, and you DECLINE MY OFFER?!

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: Well, being resurrected won't do me any good if I just die over and over again. If I couldn't survive then I surely couldn't survive now.

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: How about this then. When returning these MARROW SHARDS to me, when you inevitably come back, how about I lend you my strength? To aid you in your quest of finding your cure.

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: It does seem tempting...

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: And if I decline, I'll be stuck in this LIMBO for eternity?

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: Yep! So the choice is yours to make. We help each other, or you stay in here. Forever.

limbo_intro.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro.text: I guess that leaves me with no choice then. You have a deal.

limbo_intro.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro.text: Sweet!
